{{Current events|year=2020|month=01|day=30|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (November 2019–present)]]
**[[Warplane]]s backed by the [[Syrian Government]] strike [[Ariha]], [[Idlib Governorate]], killing at least ten people. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/warplanes-kill-10-strike-hospital-syrian-offensive-68634917?cid=clicksource_4380645_2_heads_hero_live_headlines_hed (ABC News)]
*Armed men kill at least six [[Mayangna people|Mayangna Indians]] and kidnap another ten in the [[Bosawás Biosphere Reserve]], [[Nicaragua]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-51319198 (BBC)]

;Business and economy
*[[Arvind Krishna (executive)|Arvind Krishna]] is appointed chief executive officer of [[IBM]], taking over from [[Ginni Rometty]]. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/ginni-rometty-stepping-down-as-ibm-ceo-11580420650 (''Wall Street Journal'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*Massive floods in [[Madagascar]] kill 31 people and displace 16,000 others. [https://weather.com/news/news/2020-01-30-photos-from-space-show-madagascar-flooding (''The Weather Channel'')]

;Health and environment
*[[2019–20 Wuhan coronavirus outbreak]]
**More than 6,000 passengers are barred from disembarking a [[cruise ship]] docked at [[Civitavecchia]], [[Lazio]], [[Italy]], after authorities expressed concern that two [[Chinese people|Chinese]] passengers have the [[coronavirus]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jan/30/6000-passengers-stuck-on-cruise-ship-in-italy-over-coronavirus-fears (''The Guardian'')]
**Two cases of [[Novel coronavirus (2019-nCoV)|novel coronavirus]] are confirmed in [[Italy]] after two Chinese tourists are recovered in [[Rome]]. [https://www.ilmessaggero.it/mondo/coronavirus_diretta_news_oggi_30_gennaio_2020_morti_casi_sospetti_cina_civitavecchia-5018156.html (''Il Messaggero'')]
**The [[World Health Organization]] declares a "global emergency", a rare designation that helps the international agency mobilize financial and political support to contain the outbreak. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/01/30/coronavirus-latest-updates.html (CNBC)]

;Law and crime
*The [[Virginia]], [[Nevada]], and [[Illinois]] [[State attorney general|state attorneys general]] file a lawsuit to get the [[Equal Rights Amendment]] added to the [[Constitution of the United States]].  [https://www.cnn.com/2020/01/30/politics/equal-rights-amendment-virginia-litigation-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Japan]]ese [[prosecutor]]s issue [[arrest warrant]]s against a former [[United States special operations forces]] [[United States Army|soldier]] and two others for allegedly helping [[Carlos Ghosn]] to escape from Japan. Another arrest warrant was issued against Ghosn himself. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nissan-ghosn/japan-issues-arrest-warrants-for-ex-u-s-soldier-two-others-for-ghosn-escape-idUSKBN1ZT0DK (Reuters)]
*The [[U.S. Customs and Border Protection]] reports that in August it discovered a {{convert|1,313|m|ft|abbr=on}} [[smuggling tunnel]] running from [[Tijuana]] to [[San Diego]], making it the longest tunnel of its type along the [[Mexico–United States border]]. It was possibly used by the [[Sinaloa Cartel]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-51304861 (BBC)]
*[[Catholic Church|Catholic]] [[Cardinal (Catholic Church)|Cardinal]] [[Philippe Barbarin]] is acquitted by an [[appellate court]] of having covered up allegations of [[child sexual abuse]] by a former priest. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-church-abuse-france/french-court-overturns-earlier-guilty-verdict-on-cardinal-barbarin-idUSKBN1ZT1M1 (Reuters)]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
